newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK stocks weak in morning, Cheung Kong group jumps.
newsitem.headline: HK stocks weak in morning, Cheung Kong group jumps.

text.p: Hong Kong shares were weak in Tuesday morning trade after being driven sharply higher at the opening by stocks in the Cheung Kong group, which dominated trade following Monday's annoucement of a corporate reshuffle.
The Hang Seng index was down 27.44 points at 13,416.49 after jumping to an early high of 13,564.60. Turnover was HK$4.59 billion after the first hour of trade.
"We obviously had a very strong day yesterday and I think that is why it is just simply taking a breather," said Miles Remington, sales trader at SocGen-Crosby Securities.
The Hang Seng index rose 221.14 points on Monday.
"The most important thing today was what happened with the Cheung Kong group," he said.
Hutchison plans to make a general offer for Hongkong Electric and then transfer its stake in the utility to Cheung Kong Infrastructure (CKI) in exchange for new CKI shares.
Cheung Kong will also transfer its existing shareholding of 70.66 percent in CKI to Hutchison for about HK$20.45 billion.

Shares in Cheung Kong, Cheung Kong Infrastructure, Hutchison Whampoa and Hongkong Electric resumed trading on Tuesday after being suspended on Monday due to the announcement. Analysts said the whole group was likely to benefit from the deal.
Shares in Cheung Kong jumped HK$3.75 to HK$71.50, Hutchison rose HK$1.75 to HK$60.25, Hongkong Electric rose HK$1.70 to HK$26.95 and Cheung Kong Infrastructure gained HK$0.85 to HK$22.00.

Peter Lai, associate director at OCBC Securities, said an early surge in shares of the group had prompted some profit-taking and the general tone of the market was cautious ahead of the release of U.S. economic data this week.
Shares of Sun Hung Kai Properties were down HK$0.75 at HK$95.00, Henderson Land fell HK$1.00 to HK$75.00 and HSBC Holdings slipped HK$0.50 to HK$167.50.

"People began to take profit at the higher level and that is why the market has come down," said Lai. "The market should consolidate around this level because people are still worried about the figures coming out of the States."
He saw a short-term range for the Hang Seng index of 13,000 to 13,700 points. "It really depends on the figures," said Lai.
Remington said the index was running into technical resistance around the 13,400 point area.
